description: talks to the camera like a lively salesman: the mouth opens and closes over and over as if speaking, the head nods and tilts a little, the shoulders sway, the hand holding the microphone moves it slightly toward the mouth and back; the outstretched arm on the right edge stays perfectly still where it leaves the picture; then settles back into the starting pose
subject_description: a pale TV home shopping host in a black suit, white shirt and dark red tie, holding a microphone, in front of an arch of unlit bulbs
initial_pose: turned three-quarters to the right, leaning forward, smiling, microphone in his left hand near his chest, right arm stretched out to the right toward a product
